method: Every time uses complete native construction and full native/math/cap/surface probes. Render-only snapshots copy exact positions, face loops, material indices and shader-required attributes; all shader driver values are frozen from the evaluated native. Three poses and three views match the original full-data render exactly. Pixels are reused only for identical complete geometry/attribute/material-assignment/shader-value digests. No mesh interpolation or post-warp substitute.

priorContinuation.reason: Measured window-switch reevaluation overhead; explicit-scene render keeps the original native context. Native and pose/surface checks unchanged.
Frozen evaluated shader values and lean exact render geometry remove repeated native dependencies. Quiet updates avoid dirtying equal values. Native and all pose/surface assertions retained.

continuation.reason: Continue completed times unchanged. Object carrier/attention checks retain raw ideal residuals and separately verify evaluated drivers and their reproduced positive near-zero snap. All source-shape, native-math, cap and surface assertions remain strict.
